iterations.draft_explanation_full: The table 'table1_incremental_results' details the performance metrics (R² and MSE) for various machine learning models (SVM, DT, RF, KNN, XGBoost) as the number of input features increases incrementally. For instance, when moving from 1 feature (VFA) to 9 features (VFA -> Butyrate -> Acetate -> VSS -> Propionate -> Ethanol -> COD-O -> pH -> ORP_Low), the KNN model's R² increases from 0.6449 to 0.8301, and its MSE decreases from 0.0249 to 0.0119. Similarly, the RF model shows a consistent upward trend in R² and downward trend in MSE across the feature additions. The best performance across all models in this table is observed for KNN with 9 features, achieving an R² of 0.8301 and an MSE of 0.0119.
